title: Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_zh: 消除不良种子：初始噪声鲁棒文本到图像模型遗忘方法

paragraphs.en: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization . We call this phenomenon “probabilistic forgetting”: suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.
paragraphs.zh: 机器反学习已成为一种关键的后续安全措施，能够在无需昂贵重新训练的情况下，从文本到图像（T2I）模型中清除敏感概念。 然而，我们发现当前的最先进（SOTA）方法因对噪声初始化缺乏鲁棒性而显得脆弱。 我们将这种现象称为“概率性遗忘”：尽管在其他初始化条件下看似已反学习，但在特定的随机初始噪声条件下，被抑制的概念会重新出现。 我们追溯发现，这种失败源于反学习过程中标准高斯采样与反学习目标之间的不匹配。 由于目标概念在整个反学习阶段仅出现在特定的初始噪声区域中，均匀随机采样会产生稀疏且无信息量的梯度更新，无法实现鲁棒的清除。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种自适应的概念条件采样策略，该策略能动态地将梯度更新集中在目标概念出现的区域，同时降低无信息量区域的权重。 我们将我们的框架与六种不同的 SOTA 反学习方法相结合，应用于四种扩散模型基础架构，并在安全性、对象和艺术风格反学习方面进行了评估，同时也在黑盒和白盒对抗性攻击下进行了测试。 我们的方法在四种基线方法中平均将随机初始化条件下条件裸体内容的重新出现率降低了 67.2%，并降低了两种对抗性评估中的攻击成功率。 在不同概念领域，自适应噪声采样增强了对抗性鲁棒性和非目标内容的保留能力，同时保持了具有竞争力的生成质量和目标清除性能。

paragraphs.en: Despite the reported success of prior methods, we uncover that their sampling strategy leaves a critical blind spot: a lack of robustness to the random initial noise inherent to standard image generation .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管已有方法据称取得了成功，但我们发现其采样策略存在一个关键的盲点：对标准图像生成中固有的随机初始噪声缺乏鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , a model may appear fully “unlearned” on validation seeds, yet the forbidden concept frequently re-emerges when the noise initialization varies—even under identical prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 1 所示，一个模型在验证种子上可能看起来完全“未学习”，但当噪声初始化发生变化时——即使在相同的提示下——被禁止的概念也常常会再次出现。

paragraphs.en: This exposes a major deficiency in current safety evaluations, which predominantly focus on prompt robustness. Table 1 quantitatively highlights this phenomenon: across 4,000 generated images, standard unlearning methods fail significantly, with nearly 1,000 instances still containing the theoretically ‘unlearned’ concept. Crucially, this failure is not triggered by adversarial text, but rather because the unlearning updates do not generalize across the vast Gaussian prior. This creates a dangerous “safety illusion” : a model may pass a benchmark evaluated with one fixed seed while remaining unsafe under other valid noise initializations. Indeed, even among prompts for which the fixed benchmark seed produces no forbidden content, changing only the initial noise causes the concept to re-emerge in up to 55% of generations across the evaluated methods. We term this phenomenon “probabilistic forgetting” : an apparent erasure of a concept under a limited set of initializations despite its persistence elsewhere in the noise space. This phenomenon is further illustrated in Figure 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 这暴露出当前安全性评估中的一个重大缺陷，因为这类评估主要关注提示词的鲁棒性。 表 1 从定量角度凸显了这一现象：在 4,000 张生成的图像中，标准的遗忘方法表现明显不足，其中近 1,000 个样本仍包含理论上已被“遗忘”的概念。 关键在于，这种失败并非由对抗性文本引发，而是因为遗忘更新未能覆盖整个庞大的高斯先验分布。 这产生了一种危险的“安全幻觉”：模型可能通过以某个固定种子进行评估的基准测试，但在其他有效的噪声初始化条件下仍不安全。 事实上，即使在那些使用固定基准种子时不会生成禁止内容的提示词中，仅改变初始噪声也会导致该概念在高达 55% 的生成结果中重新出现（涵盖所有评估方法）。 我们将这种现象称为“概率性遗忘”：即尽管该概念在噪声空间的其他区域仍然存在，但在有限的初始化条件下却看似被彻底清除。 图 3 进一步展示了这一现象。

paragraphs.en: We argue that this failure stems from applying standard pre-training protocols to the unlearning setting without adaptation. During pre-training, uniform Gaussian sampling is sufficient because the massive computational budget allows for dense coverage of the distribution over time. However, unlearning operates under a strictly limited gradient-update budget Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Kumari et al. (2023) : unlearning gradients can destructively perturb non-target knowledge, so simply increasing the number of steps risks degrading global image quality Koma et al. (2026) . Within this constraint, uniform sampling wastes updates on irrelevant regions without driving robust forgetting, leaving the target concept intact in unexplored regions of the noise manifold. This phenomenon is visually corroborated in Figure 2 . Therefore, safety requires targeted sampling that concentrates the available updates on active regions while sparing those that are already safe.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we address probabilistic forgetting by introducing a noise-centric perspective on diffusion unlearning. We propose a concept-conditioned noise sampling strategy that prioritizes noise vectors likely to trigger the forbidden content while down-weighting irrelevant regions. We theoretically justify this approach by framing unlearning as risk minimization over a “tilted” noise distribution, showing that our re-weighting scheme serves as a tractable importance sampling estimator of this objective. Across the four main SD 1.4 baselines, our method reduces the failure count by 61.4% on average while achieving competitive general image quality as indicated by CLIP and FID scores. More broadly, it provides a more favorable unlearning–retention trade-off: when target-erasure performance weakens slightly for some methods, the change is accompanied by substantially better preservation of non-target knowledge.

paragraphs.en: Prior research on diffusion models has established that the initial noise vector is not merely a random seed, but a semantic determinant that heavily influences generation outcomes. Two distinct paradigms have emerged from this observation. The first focuses on noise exploration , where large batches of stochastic noise are sampled for a fixed prompt to identify favorable initializations, revealing that semantic alignment and compositional success are often confined to specific, sparse regions of the noise space Karthik et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2024) ; Samuel et al. (2024) ; Mao et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2024) .

paragraphs.en: Machine unlearning (MU) Nguyen et al. (2025) ; Ginart et al. (2019) ; Cao and Yang (2015) aims to remove specific concepts or data influences from pre-trained Text-to-Image (T2I) models without the massive computational overhead of full retraining. Early optimization-based methods, such as ESD Gandikota et al. (2023) and Concept Ablation (CA) Kumari et al. (2023) , fine-tune the UNet parameters via negative guidance or attention disruption to suppress target concepts. Building on attention manipulation, Forget-Me-Not (FMN) Zhang et al. (2024a) offers an efficient solution to safely erase targeted identities, objects, or styles by re-steering and minimizing their corresponding cross-attention maps. More recently, ACE Wang et al. (2025) improved upon these protocols by enforcing erasure constraints on both conditional and unconditional noise predictions, thereby preventing erased concepts from re-emerging during image editing. Other optimization approaches like EAP Bui et al. (2024) and RECELER Huang et al. (2024) introduce adversarial preservation or lightweight eraser modules to minimize degradation. Saliency Unlearning (SalUn) Fan et al. (2023) mitigates unlearning instability by restricting optimization to influential weights identified via gradient-based saliency masks. Parallel research has focused on parameter efficiency and closed-form updates: UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) projects concept keys into a null space, CURE Biswas et al. (2025) leverages spectral analysis to identify and subtract discriminative concept subspaces via orthogonal projection, and MACE Lu et al. (2024) employs low-rank adapters (LoRA) to intercept specific attention activations. As a training-free safeguard, SAFREE Yoon et al. (2025) steers prompt embeddings away from toxic-concept subspaces and adaptively suppresses related latent features without modifying model parameters. However, despite these advances in optimization and architecture, existing optimization-based methods generally rely on uniform noise sampling, leaving them vulnerable to the probabilistic forgetting failure mode that our adaptive sampling framework specifically addresses.
paragraphs.zh: 机器遗忘（Machine unlearning，MU）——Nguyen 等人（2025）、Ginart 等人（2019）、Cao 和 Yang（2015）的研究旨在从预训练的文本到图像（Text-to-Image，T2I）模型中移除特定概念或数据影响，而无需承担完整重新训练所带来的巨大计算开销。早期的基于优化的方法，例如 ESD（Gandikota 等人，2023）和概念消融（Concept Ablation，CA，Kumari 等人，2023），通过负向引导或注意力干扰来微调 UNet 参数，以抑制目标概念的出现。在注意力操控的基础上，Forget-Me-Not（FMN，Zhang 等人，2024a）提供了一种高效的解决方案，能够通过重新引导并最小化目标身份、物体或风格所对应的交叉注意力图，从而安全地将其擦除。近期，ACE（Wang 等人，2025）通过在对条件和无条件噪声预测中同时施加擦除约束，改进了这些协议，从而防止被擦除的概念在图像编辑过程中重新出现。其他优化方法，如 EAP（Bui 等人，2024）和 RECELER（Huang 等人，2024），则引入了对抗性保留模块或轻量级擦除器模块，以最小化模型性能的退化。显著性遗忘（Saliency Unlearning，SalUn，Fan 等人，2023）通过基于梯度的显著性掩码识别出具有影响力的权重，并将优化限制在这些权重范围内，从而缓解了遗忘过程中的不稳定性问题。并行研究则聚焦于参数效率和闭式更新：UCE（Gandikota 等人，2024）将概念键投影到零空间中；CURE（Biswas 等人，2025）利用谱分析识别并通过正交投影减去具有区分性的概念子空间；MACE（Lu 等人，2024）则采用低秩适配器（LoRA）来拦截特定的注意力激活值。作为一种无需训练的防护机制，SAFREE（Yoon 等人，2025）通过将提示嵌入引导至远离有毒概念子空间的方向，并自适应地抑制相关潜在特征，而无需修改模型参数。然而，尽管在优化和架构方面取得了这些进展，现有的基于优化的方法通常依赖均匀噪声采样，这使其容易受到概率性遗忘失败模式的影响，而我们的自适应采样框架正是针对这一问题设计的。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies show that apparent erasure may block a model’s usual access route without fully removing the concept. Prompt-based attacks expose alternative textual routes: P4D automatically searches for prompts that circumvent concept removal and safety guidance Chin et al. (2023) , while Ring-A-Bell constructs black-box recovery prompts from sensitive concept representations Tsai et al. (2024) ; Koma et al. (2026) . Other work probes the generative process itself. Diffusion inversion can identify initial latents that recover erased concepts despite having likelihoods similar to ordinary samples Rusanovsky et al. (2025) , while complementary analyses distinguish methods that disrupt internal concept guidance from those that reduce the concept’s generation likelihood Lu et al. (2026) . Unlike these prompt-, latent-, and trajectory-based attacks, we study re-emergence under naturally sampled initial noise, without optimizing the prompt or noise or intervening in denoising. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first evaluation under this practical threat model: a prompt that appears safe in an initial test may reproduce the erased concept under another standard random initialization.

paragraphs.en: To demonstrate the versatility of our framework, we apply Adaptive Noise Sampling to four SOTA optimization-based methods: EAP Bui et al. (2024) , ACE Wang et al. (2025) , ESD Gandikota et al. (2023) , and RECELER Huang et al. (2024) . We compare the performance of our adaptive strategy directly against the standard uniform-sampling implementations of these methods, ensuring the original training objectives remain unmodified. Additionally, we include UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) , MACE Lu et al. (2024) , SalUn Fan et al. (2023) , and FMN Zhang et al. (2024a) as established reference baselines to contextualize our results within the broader unlearning landscape, and SAFREE Yoon et al. (2025) as a training-free inference-time safeguard. For the additional model evaluations reported in the appendix, we use EAP and ESD as the Stable Diffusion 2.1 baselines, Direct Unlearning Optimization (DUO) Park et al. (2024) as the Stable Diffusion 3 baseline, and EraseAnything Gao et al. (2025) as the FLUX.1 [dev] baseline. UCE, MACE, and SAFREE do not expose an optimization loop to which our strategy can be directly applied, whereas iterative unlearning makes the sampling distribution a controllable degree of freedom for targeting persistent noise regions. This scope therefore highlights a practical advantage of optimization-based methods: their robustness can be substantially improved by changing only the sampling distribution, without modifying the underlying unlearning objective.
paragraphs.zh: 为了展示我们框架的多功能性，我们将自适应噪声采样（Adaptive Noise Sampling）应用于四种当前最优的基于优化的方法：EAP Bui 等人（2024）、ACE Wang 等人（2025）、ESD Gandikota 等人（2023）以及 RECELER Huang 等人（2024）。我们将我们的自适应策略与这些方法的标准均匀采样实现直接进行比较，同时确保原始训练目标保持不变。此外，我们还纳入了 UCE Gandikota 等人（2024）、MACE Lu 等人（2024）、SalUn Fan 等人（2023）以及 FMN Zhang 等人（2024a）作为成熟的参考基线，以便在更广泛的“遗忘”研究领域中为我们的结果提供背景；同时还将 SAFREE Yoon 等人（2025）作为一个无需训练的推理阶段保护机制。对于附录中报告的额外模型评估，我们使用 EAP 和 ESD 作为 Stable Diffusion 2.1 的基线，Direct Unlearning Optimization (DUO) Park 等人（2024）作为 Stable Diffusion 3 的基线，以及 EraseAnything Gao 等人（2025）作为 FLUX.1 [dev] 的基线。UCE、MACE 和 SAFREE 并未暴露出可供我们的策略直接应用的优化循环，而迭代式遗忘则使采样分布成为一个可控的自由度，可用于针对持续存在的噪声区域。因此，这一研究范围凸显了基于优化的方法的一项实际优势：只需改变采样分布，无需修改底层的遗忘目标，即可显著提升其鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate nudity unlearning on a fixed set of 200 prompts randomly sampled from the nudity subset of the Six-CD benchmark ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . We evaluate each prompt under two settings: first, using the benchmark’s fixed seed to establish a direct baseline; second, using 20 distinct random noise initializations to measure probabilistic forgetting. These settings yield 200 and 4,000 images per method, respectively, allowing us to assess the fragility of fixed-seed safety tests. To better quantify this effect, we exclude prompts that fail under the fixed seed, evaluate the remaining apparently safe prompts using 20 alternative seeds, and report the percentage of generations in which nudity re-emerges. As shown in Table 1 , re-emergence ranges from 4% to 25% for the four optimization baselines and falls to 0.5–10% with Adaptive Noise Sampling. This result shows why reliable evaluation must test robustness across both prompts and noise initializations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在从 Six-CD 基准测试的裸体子集中随机抽取的 200 个固定提示词集合上，评估了裸体内容的去学习效果（Ren et al., 2025）。 我们对每个提示词在两种设置下进行了评估：首先，使用基准测试的固定种子建立直接基线；其次，使用 20 种不同的随机噪声初始化来衡量概率性遗忘。 这些设置分别产生了每方法 200 张和 4,000 张图片，使我们能够评估固定种子安全测试的脆弱性。 为了更好地量化这种影响，我们排除了在固定种子下失败的提示词，使用 20 种替代种子对剩余看似安全的提示词进行评估，并报告了裸体内容重新出现的生成比例。 如表 1 所示，对于四种优化基线方法，裸体内容的重新出现率介于 4% 到 25% 之间，而采用自适应噪声采样后，该比率降至 0.5%–10%。 这一结果说明，可靠的评估为何必须同时测试提示词和噪声初始化方面的鲁棒性。

sents.en: We evaluate each prompt under two settings: first, using the benchmark’s fixed seed to establish a direct baseline; second, using 20 distinct random noise initializations to measure probabilistic forgetting.
sents.zh: 我们对每个提示词在两种设置下进行了评估：首先，使用基准测试的固定种子建立直接基线；其次，使用 20 种不同的随机噪声初始化来衡量概率性遗忘。

sents.en: These settings yield 200 and 4,000 images per method, respectively, allowing us to assess the fragility of fixed-seed safety tests.
sents.zh: 这些设置分别产生了每方法 200 张和 4,000 张图片，使我们能够评估固定种子安全测试的脆弱性。

sents.en: To better quantify this effect, we exclude prompts that fail under the fixed seed, evaluate the remaining apparently safe prompts using 20 alternative seeds, and report the percentage of generations in which nudity re-emerges.
sents.zh: 为了更好地量化这种影响，我们排除了在固定种子下失败的提示词，使用 20 种替代种子对剩余看似安全的提示词进行评估，并报告了裸体内容重新出现的生成比例。

sents.en: As shown in Table 1 , re-emergence ranges from 4% to 25% for the four optimization baselines and falls to 0.5–10% with Adaptive Noise Sampling.
sents.zh: 如表 1 所示，对于四种优化基线方法，裸体内容的重新出现率介于 4% 到 25% 之间，而采用自适应噪声采样后，该比率降至 0.5%–10%。

sents.en: This result shows why reliable evaluation must test robustness across both prompts and noise initializations.
sents.zh: 这一结果说明，可靠的评估为何必须同时测试提示词和噪声初始化方面的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: This work studies probabilistic forgetting in text-to-image diffusion models: a concept that appears suppressed under one initial noise vector may re-emerge under another valid initialization. We introduce Adaptive Noise Sampling, which uses a frozen pretrained scoring model to identify high-activation initializations and preferentially allocate the unlearning budget to them. Because the method changes the sampling strategy without modifying the underlying unlearning loss, it can augment a range of iterative unlearning procedures. In the Stable Diffusion 1.4 nudity experiments, the proposed strategy reduces conditional concept re-emergence across all four iterative baselines (Table 1 ). Additional nudity evaluations on Stable Diffusion 2.1, Stable Diffusion 3, and FLUX.1 [dev] show lower failure counts under the 20-seed protocol (Appendices L , M , and N ). The style experiments improve or preserve the reported removal and retention metrics, whereas the object experiments primarily improve non-target retention with method-dependent changes in erased-class accuracy (Appendices F and G ). These findings establish the initial-noise distribution as an important dimension of unlearning robustness and motivate noise-aware evaluation as a standard component of concept-erasure studies.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了文本到图像扩散模型中的概率性遗忘现象：在一种初始噪声向量下被抑制的概念，可能在另一种有效的初始化设置下重新出现。 我们提出了自适应噪声采样方法，该方法利用一个冻结的预训练评分模型来识别高激活的初始化设置，并优先将去学习预算分配给这些设置。 由于该方法在不修改底层去学习损失的情况下改变了采样策略，因此可以增强多种迭代去学习流程。 在 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的裸体内容实验中，所提出的策略在所有四种迭代基线方法中均降低了条件概念的重现率（表 1）。 在 Stable Diffusion 2.1、Stable Diffusion 3 和 FLUX.1 [dev] 上进行的额外裸体内容评估显示，在 20 个种子协议下，失败次数更少（附录 L、M 和 N）。 在风格实验中，该方法改进或保持了已报告的移除与保留指标；而在物体实验中，主要提升了非目标内容的保留率，同时擦除类别的准确率也出现了方法依赖的变化（附录 F 和 G）。 这些发现确立了初始噪声分布是去学习鲁棒性的重要维度，并推动了将噪声感知评估作为概念擦除研究的标准化组成部分。

sents.en: Because the method changes the sampling strategy without modifying the underlying unlearning loss, it can augment a range of iterative unlearning procedures.
sents.zh: 由于该方法在不修改底层去学习损失的情况下改变了采样策略，因此可以增强多种迭代去学习流程。

sents.en: In the Stable Diffusion 1.4 nudity experiments, the proposed strategy reduces conditional concept re-emergence across all four iterative baselines (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的裸体内容实验中，所提出的策略在所有四种迭代基线方法中均降低了条件概念的重现率（表 1）。

sents.en: Additional nudity evaluations on Stable Diffusion 2.1, Stable Diffusion 3, and FLUX.1 [dev] show lower failure counts under the 20-seed protocol (Appendices L , M , and N ).
sents.zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 2.1、Stable Diffusion 3 和 FLUX.1 [dev] 上进行的额外裸体内容评估显示，在 20 个种子协议下，失败次数更少（附录 L、M 和 N）。

sents.en: The style experiments improve or preserve the reported removal and retention metrics, whereas the object experiments primarily improve non-target retention with method-dependent changes in erased-class accuracy (Appendices F and G ).
sents.zh: 在风格实验中，该方法改进或保持了已报告的移除与保留指标；而在物体实验中，主要提升了非目标内容的保留率，同时擦除类别的准确率也出现了方法依赖的变化（附录 F 和 G）。

sents.en: These findings establish the initial-noise distribution as an important dimension of unlearning robustness and motivate noise-aware evaluation as a standard component of concept-erasure studies.
sents.zh: 这些发现确立了初始噪声分布是去学习鲁棒性的重要维度，并推动了将噪声感知评估作为概念擦除研究的标准化组成部分。

paragraphs.en: A natural concern is that Adaptive Noise Sampling may be dependent on the particular classifier used to guide unlearning. We address this concern through experiments with five pretrained guidance architectures: NudeNet; CLIP ViT-L/14, used for both zero-shot nudity detection and artistic-style guidance; and InceptionV3, EfficientNet, and MobileNetV2 for object concepts (Appendices F , H , and I ). We further use independent Open-NSFW2, ResNet-50, and UnlearnCanvas classifiers for evaluation, together with human judgments for nudity (Appendix Q ). Finally, we stress-test NudeNet under controlled image corruption to characterize when its confidence begins to degrade, finding that Adaptive Noise Sampling continues to outperform the standard baselines even with substantially weakened guidance (Tables 9 and 10 ). Taken together, the results across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning show that the sampling principle generalizes across concept domains, classifier families, and vision–language guidance without requiring changes to its formulation, although the magnitude of the improvement can vary with the guidance model.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的担忧是，自适应噪声采样可能依赖于用于指导去学习的特定分类器。 我们通过使用五种预训练引导架构的实验来解决这一担忧：NudeNet；CLIP ViT-L/14（既用于零样本裸体检测，也用于艺术风格引导）；以及用于物体概念的 InceptionV3、EfficientNet 和 MobileNetV2（附录 F、H 和 I）。 此外，我们还使用独立的 Open-NSFW2、ResNet-50 和 UnlearnCanvas 分类器进行评估，并结合人类对裸体的判断（附录 Q）。 最后，我们在受控图像损坏条件下对 NudeNet 进行了压力测试，以明确其置信度何时开始下降，结果发现，即使在引导信号大幅削弱的情况下，自适应噪声采样仍然优于标准基线模型（表 9 和表 10）。 综合来看，在安全、物体和艺术风格去学习方面的结果表明，该采样原则能够跨概念领域、分类器家族以及视觉-语言引导进行泛化，而无需对其公式进行修改，尽管改进的程度可能因引导模型而异。

In practice, we sample a large batch of N N candidates to estimate the weights w i w_{i} , but restrict backpropagation to the subset of M M samples ( M ≪ N M\ll N ) with the highest importance scores. This decouples forward-pass exploration from backward-pass optimization, improving the information per update and accelerating convergence. paragraphs.en: The per-style results show that the average gains in the main paper are consistent across targets rather than being driven by a small subset of styles. ACE and RECELER already achieve 100% UA for every target, leaving no room for further improvement in removal accuracy; nevertheless, Adaptive Noise Sampling improves retention for every style, increasing mean IRA/CRA by 1.20/2.87 points for ACE and by 2.36/2.06 points for RECELER. EAP exhibits the largest removal gain: UA increases by approximately 4.1 points for every target and reaches 100% on six of the ten styles, while mean IRA and CRA also increase by 2.12 and 2.81 points, respectively. ESD likewise improves all three metrics for every target, with mean gains of 0.60 points in UA, 2.51 points in IRA, and 2.75 points in CRA. Some method-specific weaknesses remain—for example, Crayon has the lowest UA for ESD (85.00%), Monet has its lowest IRA (69.06%), and Picasso and Van Gogh remain the lowest-CRA targets for EAP (82.23%) and RECELER (83.60%), respectively. Overall, the absence of a per-style trade-off—UA never decreases, while IRA and CRA increase in every comparison—indicates that the adaptive strategy strengthens concept removal or preserves an already saturated removal rate while consistently reducing collateral degradation of non-target styles and content.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether our noise-aware unlearning framework generalizes beyond abstract concepts, we apply it to object unlearning. Following prior work ( Biswas et al., 2025 ) , we conduct experiments on ten object categories from the Imagenette benchmark Howard and Gugger (2020) . Each target object (e.g., French Horn ) is treated as the forget concept. We use a frozen InceptionV3 classifier ( Szegedy et al., 2015 ) as the guidance classifier f f during training and the architecturally distinct ResNet-50 ( He et al., 2016 ) for evaluation. This separation prevents circular evaluation and classifier-specific reward hacking. To ensure statistical robustness, for the erased class we generate 500 images using distinct random seeds and report the ResNet-50 Top-1 accuracy (lower is better). For preservation, we generate 500 images for each of the nine remaining object classes (4,500 images total) and report the averaged Top-1 accuracy (higher is better).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们的噪声感知遗忘框架是否能在抽象概念之外实现泛化，我们将其应用于对象遗忘任务。 遵循先前的研究（Biswas 等人，2025），我们在 Imagenette 基准数据集（Howard 和 Gugger，2020）中的十个对象类别上进行了实验。 每个目标对象（例如法国号）都被视为需要遗忘的概念。 在训练过程中，我们使用一个冻结的 InceptionV3 分类器（Szegedy 等人，2015）作为指导分类器 f f，而在评估阶段则使用架构不同的 ResNet-50（He 等人，2016）。 这种分离避免了循环评估以及针对特定分类器的奖励操纵问题。 为确保统计稳健性，对于被擦除的类别，我们使用不同的随机种子生成 500 张图像，并报告 ResNet-50 的 Top-1 准确率（数值越低越好）。 在保留任务中，我们为其余九个对象类别分别生成 500 张图像（总计 4,500 张），并报告平均 Top-1 准确率（数值越高越好）。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 reports class-wise results. While baselines like EAP and RECELER achieve near-zero erasure error on standard evaluations, they often suffer from degradation in general model utility (e.g., RECELER drops to 72.5% on non-target classes). Applying our Adaptive Noise Sampling significantly mitigates this trade-off. For example, with RECELER , our method boosts non-target preservation by +7.4 points (72.5% → \to 79.9%) while maintaining robust erasure ( < 1 % <1\% error). Similarly, for EAP and ESD, while our method introduces a negligible relaxation in absolute erasure (e.g., EAP error shifts from 0.0 to 1.1), this trade-off is outweighed by the substantial + 1.2 +1.2 point recovery in global class preservation, demonstrating that we prevent the destructive “over-unlearning” of the baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 表5报告了按类别划分的结果。 尽管EAP和RECELER等基线方法在标准评估中实现了接近零的擦除错误，但它们通常在模型整体性能上出现下降（例如，RECELER在非目标类别上的准确率降至72.5%）。 应用我们的自适应噪声采样方法显著缓解了这种权衡问题。 例如，对于RECELER，我们的方法将非目标类别的保留率提升了+7.4个百分点（从72.5%提升至79.9%），同时保持了稳健的擦除效果（错误率<1%）。 同样地，对于EAP和ESD，尽管我们的方法在绝对擦除方面引入了可忽略的放宽（例如，EAP的错误率从0.0变为1.1），但这种权衡被全局类别保留率的大幅提升（+1.2个百分点）所抵消，这表明我们避免了基线方法中那种破坏性的“过度遗忘”现象。

paragraphs.en: We next stress-test the NudeNet guidance signal under controlled image corruption. First, we isolate the classifier itself to establish a baseline of its inherent stability. paragraphs.en: As detailed in Table 10 , even when the guidance signal is intentionally corrupted, our adaptive method consistently outperforms the standard uniform-sampling baselines. For example, when applying our adaptive framework to ESD, it exhibits remarkable robustness; even at the extreme noise level of σ = 0.15 \sigma=0.15 , it restricts failures to 308, easily surpassing the uncorrupted standard ESD baseline (510 failures). Likewise, even at σ = 0.10 \sigma=0.10 where the classifier’s confidence is severely degraded, our approach applied to ACE yields a failure count of 148, which remains vastly superior to the standard ACE baseline (491 failures). Similar resilience is observed across the other frameworks. When integrating our method with EAP under σ = 0.10 \sigma=0.10 noise, it limits failures to 734, a substantial improvement over the standard EAP baseline’s 1142 failures. Furthermore, when applied to RECELER at the highest evaluated noise level ( σ = 0.15 \sigma=0.15 ), our framework incurs only 433 failures—still significantly outperforming the uncorrupted standard RECELER baseline (693 failures) while simultaneously improving the CLIP score ( 0.237 → 0.244 0.237\to 0.244 ). This demonstrates that our framework degrades gracefully across diverse unlearning architectures; it relies on the directional accuracy of the classifier rather than perfect point-wise precision, maintaining strong unlearning efficacy and general image quality (CLIP) even under suboptimal guidance conditions.

paragraphs.en: The results in Table 14 highlight the distinct roles of exploration and exploitation in our framework. Increasing the exploration pool ( N N ) allows the framework to discover more elusive, high-activation noise trajectories. Concurrently, increasing the update batch ( M M ) provides a stronger, more stable gradient signal for unlearning. While maximizing both parameters naturally yields the lowest failure rates (e.g., N = 40 , M = 8 N=40,M=8 achieves 52 failures on ACE), we observe heavily diminishing returns as computational costs scale. We empirically selected N = 20 N=20 and M = 4 M=4 for our primary experiments as it strikes the optimal trade-off: it achieves near-optimal robustness (60 failures on ACE) while strictly bounding the memory overhead of the backward pass to match a standard batch size of 4.
paragraphs.zh: 表 14 中的结果凸显了探索与利用在我们框架中的不同作用。 扩大探索池（N N）能让框架发现更多难以捕捉的高激活噪声轨迹。 同时，增大更新批量（M M）能为去学习提供更强、更稳定的梯度信号。 虽然同时最大化这两个参数自然会产生最低的失败率（例如，N = 40，M = 8 在 ACE 上实现了 52 次失败），但我们观察到，随着计算成本的增加，收益会急剧递减。 在我们的主要实验中，我们通过实证选择了 N = 20 和 M = 4，因为这达到了最佳权衡：既实现了接近最优的鲁棒性（ACE 上 60 次失败），又将反向传播的内存开销严格限制在与标准批量大小 4 一致的水平。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether Adaptive Noise Sampling generalizes beyond U-Net-based diffusion models, we conduct a proof-of-concept experiment on Stable Diffusion 3 (SD3), which uses a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture. We use Direct Unlearning Optimization (DUO) Park et al. (2024) , a DiT-compatible unlearning method, as the baseline and apply our sampling strategy without modifying the underlying DUO objective. We use NudeNet for adaptive guidance and Open-NSFW2 for evaluation under both the standard single-seed protocol and the more rigorous 20-seed protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估自适应噪声采样能否在基于 U-Net 的扩散模型之外实现泛化，我们在采用扩散变换器（DiT）架构的 Stable Diffusion 3（SD3）上开展了一项概念验证实验。我们将 Park 等人（2024）提出的直接遗忘优化（DUO）方法作为基线，该方法与 DiT 架构兼容；同时，在不修改底层 DUO 目标函数的情况下应用了我们的采样策略。我们使用 NudeNet 进行自适应引导，并在标准单种子协议和更严格的 20 种子协议下，利用 Open-NSFW2 进行评估。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 16 , Adaptive Noise Sampling improves the robustness of DUO on SD3. It reduces the single-seed failure count from 60 to 46, a 23.3 % 23.3\% reduction, and the 20-seed failure count from 1245 to 938, a 24.7 % 24.7\% reduction. At the same time, the CLIP score increases slightly from 0.2385 0.2385 to 0.2399 0.2399 , indicating that the improved erasure does not compromise text–image alignment. These results provide initial evidence that our framework transfers to DiT architectures without architecture-specific modifications and reduces the probabilistic tail risk associated with unfavorable noise initializations.

paragraphs.en: To further validate our findings beyond automatic classifiers, we conduct a human evaluation on nudity unlearning. We randomly select 100 prompts from the nudity subset and generate images using 20 random seeds per prompt, resulting in 2000 images per method. Five annotators (a mix of undergraduate and graduate students) were recruited for the study. Prior to annotation, participants were explicitly informed that the images may contain nudity and provided consent to proceed.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在自动分类器之外进一步验证我们的研究结果，我们对裸体内容遗忘进行了人类评估。 我们从裸体内容子集中随机选取了 100 个提示，并为每个提示使用 20 个随机种子生成图像，最终每种方法共产生了 2000 张图像。 我们招募了五名标注员（包括本科生和研究生）参与这项研究。 在开始标注之前，我们明确告知参与者，这些图像可能包含裸体内容，并获得了他们继续参与的同意。

paragraphs.en: Each image was independently annotated with a binary label indicating whether nudity is present. Table 20 reports the total number of images labeled as nude (failure count) and the corresponding failure ratio. Consistent with the automatic evaluation, our method substantially reduces the presence of nudity compared to all baselines. In particular, when applied on top of ACE and ESD, our approach achieves the lowest failure rates, indicating more reliable suppression of the target concept across diverse noise initializations. These results confirm that the improvements observed with automated detectors translate to human perception, strengthening the practical relevance of our unlearning framework.

While baseline approaches often exhibit residual appearances of the target concept or noticeable degradation in image quality, our method more reliably suppresses the concept across stochastic samples, maintaining visual plausibility and prompt faithfulness. Together, these examples illustrate that explicitly accounting for noise-space structure leads to more robust and stable unlearning behavior under both deterministic and stochastic generation settings.
